You are implementing ONE requirement in the Apache Hadoop source tree at /workspace (a real upstream repo checked out at an earlier state).

REQUIREMENT SLUG: hadoop-vote-rc-version
REQUIREMENT FILE: /workspace/requirements/hadoop-vote-rc-version.yaml   <-- READ THIS FIRST

The `title:` field names the real upstream Apache Hadoop JIRA / git commit. Your job is to reproduce that upstream change as faithfully as you can from the requirement text plus the code you find in the tree. Hidden tests derived from the real upstream commit will grade the result, so EXACT naming matters:
  * new/changed configuration keys and their default values (and their entries in *-default.xml)
  * new class / interface / method / field / metric names and their visibility
  * log message wording and format placeholders
  * behavioural details (return values, exception types, ordering, off-by-one boundaries)
If the requirement text names an identifier (class, method, config key, metric, constant), use that identifier verbatim.

HOW TO WORK
1. Read the requirement yaml. Note the JIRA id and the module it belongs to (HDFS / YARN / MAPREDUCE / HADOOP-common / tools).
2. Locate the real code with Grep/Glob. Read enough surrounding code (and the existing tests for it) to make a correct, idiomatic change.
3. Implement the change. Match the surrounding code style, license headers, checkstyle habits (2-space indent, 80-col-ish, final where used, LOG placeholders `{}`).
4. If the change adds a config key, also add it to the matching `*-default.xml` (hdfs-default.xml / core-default.xml / yarn-default.xml / mapred-default.xml) with a sensible description, and to the `DFSConfigKeys`/`YarnConfiguration`/etc. constants class the module uses. Some modules have a TestYarnConfigurationFields / TestHdfsConfigFields style test that requires the xml and the constant to agree - keep them in sync.
5. If the upstream change would have come with tests, add or extend the corresponding test class under the same module (src/test/java/...). Keep tests deterministic and cheap. Do not add tests that need network or a real cluster beyond the usual MiniDFSCluster/MiniYARNCluster idioms already used in that test file.
6. Do NOT run maven/mvn or cmake (there is no warm build environment; it wastes your time). Instead be rigorous by inspection: every symbol you reference must exist (grep to confirm), every new import must be needed and correct, braces/parens balanced, no stale references left behind. Re-read your own final diff (`git diff -- <your files>`) before finishing and fix anything sloppy.
7. Scope discipline: change ONLY what this requirement needs. Do not reformat unrelated lines, do not fix unrelated warnings, do not touch other subsystems. Other agents are concurrently implementing ~380 other requirements in this same working tree.

FORBIDDEN COMMANDS (they would destroy other agents' concurrent work): git checkout / switch / stash / reset / revert / clean / rebase / merge / cherry-pick, `git add -A` or `git add .` without an explicit pathspec, `git commit --amend`, `git rm` of files you did not create, and any `mvn`/`gradle` invocation.

WHEN YOUR IMPLEMENTATION IS COMPLETE - commit it yourself with exactly this shape (substitute the real repo-relative paths you touched, space separated, and keep the flock):

  cd /workspace && flock /tmp/hadoop-git.lock bash -c 'git add -A -- PATH1 PATH2 ... && git diff --cached --binary > requirement_patches/hadoop-vote-rc-version.diff && git commit -q -m "impl: hadoop-vote-rc-version" && git log --oneline -1 && wc -c requirement_patches/hadoop-vote-rc-version.diff'

Rules for that step:
  * List every file you created, modified or deleted as an explicit pathspec. Never a bare directory like `.`.
  * requirement_patches/hadoop-vote-rc-version.diff MUST come out non-empty (wc -c > 0). If `git commit` reports "nothing to commit", another agent already committed your lines: verify the requirement is genuinely satisfied in the working tree, then report that in your notes.
  * Do not touch requirement_patches/ for any other slug.
  * IMPORTANT - a previous interrupted run left some UNCOMMITTED work in this tree. Before you start, run `cd /workspace && git status --short` and inspect `git diff` for the files you expect to touch. If part or all of this requirement is already implemented in the working tree but not yet committed, do NOT redo it from scratch: review it critically, finish/correct anything missing or wrong, then stage exactly those paths and commit as above. That uncommitted work is yours to claim when it belongs to this slug.

FINALLY return ONLY a JSON object (this is your return value, not a message to a human):
{"slug":"hadoop-vote-rc-version","status":"done"|"partial"|"blocked","files":["..."],"committed":true|false,"patch_bytes":<int>,"summary":"<=3 sentences on what you changed","notes":"anything the orchestrator must know (conflicts, follow-ups, uncertainty)"}

title: HADOOP-18228. Update hadoop-vote to use HADOOP_RC_VERSION dir
category: other
requirement: '## Context

  Release managers running `hadoop-vote.sh` expect the vote workflow to stage artifacts under the same release-candidate directory name encoded in the source URL.

  ## Desired outcome

  The script should use `HADOOP_RC_VERSION` as the output/work directory so repeated vote checks line up exactly with release-candidate naming.

  ## Acceptance signals

  Release-vote automation downloads and stages artifacts under the RC directory name without manual renaming or path fixes.

  '

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one
3	# or more contributor license agreements.  See the NOTICE file
4	# distributed with this work for additional information
5	# regarding copyright ownership.  The ASF licenses this file
6	# to you under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the
7	# "License"); you may not use this file except in compliance
8	# with the License.  You may obtain a copy of the License at
9	#
10	#   http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
11	#
12	# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,
13	# software distributed under the License is distributed on an
14	# "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY
15	# KIND, either express or implied.  See the License for the
16	# specific language governing permissions and limitations
17	# under the License.
18	
19	# This script is useful to perform basic sanity tests for the given
20	# Hadoop RC. It checks for the Checksum, Signature, Rat check,
21	# Build from source and building tarball from the source.
22	
23	set -e -o pipefail
24	
25	usage() {
26	  SCRIPT=$(basename "${BASH_SOURCE[@]}")
27	
28	  cat << __EOF
29	hadoop-vote. A script for standard vote which verifies the following items
30	1. Checksum of sources and binaries
31	2. Signature of sources and binaries
32	3. Rat check
33	4. Built from source
34	5. Built tar from source
35	
36	Usage: ${SCRIPT} -s | --source <url> [-k | --key <signature>] [-f | --keys-file-url <url>] [-o | --output-dir </path/to/use>] [-D property[=value]] [-P profiles]
37	       ${SCRIPT} -h | --help
38	
39	  -h | --help                   Show this screen.
40	  -s | --source '<url>'         A URL pointing to the release candidate sources and binaries
41	                                e.g. https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/hadoop/hadoop-<version>RC0/
42	  -k | --key '<signature>'      A signature of the public key, e.g. 9AD2AE49
43	  -f | --keys-file-url '<url>'   the URL of the key file, default is
44	                                https://downloads.apache.org/hadoop/common/KEYS
45	  -o | --output-dir '</path>'   directory which has the stdout and stderr of each verification target
46	  -D |                          list of maven properties to set for the mvn invocations, e.g. <-D hbase.profile=2.0 -D skipTests> Defaults to unset
47	  -P |                          list of maven profiles to set for the build from source, e.g. <-P native -P yarn-ui>
48	__EOF
49	}
50	
51	MVN_PROPERTIES=()
52	MVN_PROFILES=()
53	
54	while ((${#})); do
55	  case "${1}" in
56	    -h | --help )
57	      usage; exit 0 ;;
58	    -s | --source )
59	      SOURCE_URL="${2}"; shift 2 ;;
60	    -k | --key )
61	      SIGNING_KEY="${2}"; shift 2 ;;
62	    -f | --keys-file-url )
63	      KEY_FILE_URL="${2}"; shift 2 ;;
64	    -o | --output-dir )
65	      OUTPUT_DIR="${2}"; shift 2 ;;
66	    -D )
67	      MVN_PROPERTIES+=("-D ${2}"); shift 2 ;;
68	    -P )
69	      MVN_PROFILES+=("-P ${2}"); shift 2 ;;
70	    * )
71	      usage >&2; exit 1             ;;
72	  esac
73	done
74	
75	# Source url must be provided
76	if [ -z "${SOURCE_URL}" ]; then
77	  usage;
78	  exit 1
79	fi
80	
81	cat << __EOF
82	Although This tool helps verifying Hadoop RC build and unit tests,
83	operator may still consider verifying the following manually:
84	1. Verify the API compatibility report
85	2. Integration/performance/benchmark tests
86	3. Object store specific Integration tests against an endpoint
87	4. Verify overall unit test stability from Jenkins builds or locally
88	5. Other concerns if any
89	__EOF
90	
91	[[ "${SOURCE_URL}" != */ ]] && SOURCE_URL="${SOURCE_URL}/"
92	HADOOP_RC_VERSION=$(tr "/" "\n" <<< "${SOURCE_URL}" | tail -n2)
93	HADOOP_VERSION=$(echo "${HADOOP_RC_VERSION}" | sed -e 's/-RC[0-9]//g' | sed -e 's/hadoop-//g')
94	JAVA_VERSION=$(java -version 2>&1 | cut -f3 -d' ' | head -n1 | sed -e 's/"//g')
95	OUTPUT_DIR="${OUTPUT_DIR:-$(pwd)}"
96	
97	if [ ! -d "${OUTPUT_DIR}" ]; then
98	    echo "Output directory ${OUTPUT_DIR} does not exist, please create it before running this script."
99	    exit 1
100	fi
101	
102	OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX="${OUTPUT_DIR}"/"${HADOOP_RC_VERSION}"
103	
104	# default value for verification targets, 0 = failed
105	SIGNATURE_PASSED=0
106	CHECKSUM_PASSED=0
107	RAT_CHECK_PASSED=0
108	BUILD_FROM_SOURCE_PASSED=0
109	BUILD_TAR_FROM_SOURCE_PASSED=0
110	
111	function download_and_import_keys() {
112	    KEY_FILE_URL="${KEY_FILE_URL:-https://downloads.apache.org/hadoop/common/KEYS}"
113	    echo "Obtain and import the publisher key(s) from ${KEY_FILE_URL}"
114	    # download the keys file into file KEYS
115	    wget -O KEYS "${KEY_FILE_URL}"
116	    gpg --import KEYS
117	    if [ -n "${SIGNING_KEY}" ]; then
118	        gpg --list-keys "${SIGNING_KEY}"
119	    fi
120	}
121	
122	function download_release_candidate () {
123	    # get all files from release candidate repo
124	    wget -r -np -N -nH --cut-dirs 4 "${SOURCE_URL}"
125	}
126	
127	function verify_signatures() {
128	    rm -f "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_verify_signatures
129	    for file in *.tar.gz; do
130	        gpg --verify "${file}".asc "${file}" 2>&1 | tee -a "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_verify_signatures && SIGNATURE_PASSED=1 || SIGNATURE_PASSED=0
131	    done
132	}
133	
134	function verify_checksums() {
135	    rm -f "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_verify_checksums
136	    SHA_EXT=$(find . -name "*.sha*" | awk -F '.' '{ print $NF }' | head -n 1)
137	    for file in *.tar.gz; do
138	        sha512sum --tag "${file}" > "${file}"."${SHA_EXT}".tmp
139	        diff "${file}"."${SHA_EXT}".tmp "${file}"."${SHA_EXT}" 2>&1 | tee -a "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_verify_checksums && CHECKSUM_PASSED=1 || CHECKSUM_PASSED=0
140	        rm -f "${file}"."${SHA_EXT}".tmp
141	    done
142	}
143	
144	function unzip_from_source() {
145	    tar -zxvf hadoop-"${HADOOP_VERSION}"-src.tar.gz
146	    cd hadoop-"${HADOOP_VERSION}"-src
147	}
148	
149	function rat_test() {
150	    rm -f "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_rat_test
151	    mvn clean apache-rat:check "${MVN_PROPERTIES[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_rat_test && RAT_CHECK_PASSED=1
152	}
153	
154	function build_from_source() {
155	    rm -f "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_build_from_source
156	    # No unit test run.
157	    mvn clean install "${MVN_PROPERTIES[@]}" -DskipTests "${MVN_PROFILES[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_build_from_source && BUILD_FROM_SOURCE_PASSED=1
158	}
159	
160	function build_tar_from_source() {
161	    rm -f "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_build_tar_from_source
162	    # No unit test run.
163	    mvn clean package "${MVN_PROPERTIES[@]}" -Pdist -DskipTests -Dtar -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true 2>&1 | tee "${OUTPUT_PATH_PREFIX}"_build_tar_from_source && BUILD_TAR_FROM_SOURCE_PASSED=1
164	}
165	
166	function execute() {
167	   ${1} || print_when_exit
168	}
169	
170	function print_when_exit() {
171	  cat << __EOF
172	        * Signature: $( ((SIGNATURE_PASSED)) && echo "ok" || echo "failed" )
173	        * Checksum : $( ((CHECKSUM_PASSED)) && echo "ok" || echo "failed" )
174	        * Rat check (${JAVA_VERSION}): $( ((RAT_CHECK_PASSED)) && echo "ok" || echo "failed" )
175	         - mvn clean apache-rat:check ${MVN_PROPERTIES[@]}
176	        * Built from source (${JAVA_VERSION}): $( ((BUILD_FROM_SOURCE_PASSED)) && echo "ok" || echo "failed" )
177	         - mvn clean install ${MVN_PROPERTIES[@]} -DskipTests ${MVN_PROFILES[@]}
178	        * Built tar from source (${JAVA_VERSION}): $( ((BUILD_TAR_FROM_SOURCE_PASSED)) && echo "ok" || echo "failed" )
179	         - mvn clean package ${MVN_PROPERTIES[@]} -Pdist -DskipTests -Dtar -Dmaven.javadoc.skip=true
180	__EOF
181	  if ((CHECKSUM_PASSED)) && ((SIGNATURE_PASSED)) && ((RAT_CHECK_PASSED)) && ((BUILD_FROM_SOURCE_PASSED)) && ((BUILD_TAR_FROM_SOURCE_PASSED)) ; then
182	    exit 0
183	  fi
184	  exit 1
185	}
186	
187	pushd "${OUTPUT_DIR}"
188	
189	download_and_import_keys
190	download_release_candidate
191	
192	execute verify_signatures
193	execute verify_checksums
194	execute unzip_from_source
195	execute rat_test
196	execute build_from_source
197	execute build_tar_from_source
198	
199	popd
200	
201	print_when_exit
202
